desc: 室内定点如厕，表层导流锁水、底层防漏护地板
name: 犬猫室内训练尿垫干爽款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清整叠片数感与单片结构，赢下首次点击。
用真实居家定点如厕画面让养宠人代入，建立情感认同。
把地板渗液受损的具体麻烦摊开，制造解决问题紧迫感。
shots.textZone: 两块面板底部各一行状态标签位

shots.intent: 用分层构造剖视讲清防漏机制，解释产品为什么能做到。
shots.textZone: 上部主标题带与每层一枚引线胶囊标签位，下方一排编号说明位

shots.intent: 以液体被压边兜住并迅速下渗的实证画面坐实防漏卖点。
shots.textZone: 底部横向色带承载一行短句位与一枚引线箭头

shots.intent: 帮买家按犬型挑规格，消除选错尺寸的下单顾虑。
shots.textZone: 顶部一行提问式标题位、行首两列标签位与各空白表格单元位

shots.intent: 以整叠内容物与留空凭证框收口，降低决策风险感。
shots.textZone: 下部一排空白印章框与两条留空指示条位，其上一行短句位

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and diagram boards, warm off-white wall #F0EEE9 plus pale wood floor #E6DAC8 for in-room scenes, warm cream board #FBF3E4 for chart screens
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and small numbered discs in bright orange #EE7623, no filled 3D badges
style.lightingSystem: bright soft high-key studio light, front-left key with fill card, gentle contact shadows only, one sweeping side light when surface texture must read
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean hygienic pet-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white background #FFFFFF, pale blue-grey edge banding #BBD7EC, warm off-white panel #F6F1EA and one bright orange accent #EE7623; neutral bright soft high-key studio lighting with a front-left key, fill card and gentle contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with sparse placeholder copy; thin single-weight line icons and small numbered discs in bright orange #EE7623; seamless white boards for packshots and diagrams, pale matte wood floor for in-room scenes; stable product scale, centering and unfolded-sheet geometry; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no invented numbers or seal text
style.presentationRules: stable product scale and centering across the set; the sheet shown laid flat or as a neat stack with one unit fully unfolded; geometry never re-designed
style.surfaceSystem: pale matte wood floor #E6DAC8 and neutral matte board #F6F1EA, no gloss, no reflections of the surroundings
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one headline weight plus short label lines, sparse copy carried by placeholders
